callouts.id: 对自变量进行二进制展开求积分#2
callouts.title: 转换为概率积分
callouts.body:
$$\int_{\Omega}\left(\sum_{n\geq 1}\frac{\lfloor2^nX(\omega)\rfloor}{3^n}\right)^2\,dP(\omega)$$或者说我们定义一个新的随机变量$Y(\omega)=\sum_{n\geq 1}\frac{\lfloor2^nX(\omega)\rfloor}{3^n}$，其中$X\sim U(0,1)$可以是**任意**一个均匀分布的随机变量。
那么现在要求概率积分$$\int_{\Omega}Y^2(\omega)\,dP(\omega)$$

classification_result.id: 对自变量进行二进制展开求积分#2

if_strategy_template.strategy_name_en: Convert an Integral on [0,1] into an Expectation
if_strategy_template.summary_en: Treat the integration variable as a uniformly distributed random variable \(X\\sim U(0,1)\), and rewrite the integral as an expectation of a derived random variable. This allows probabilistic tools and distributional arguments to be used.
if_strategy_template.applicability: Applies when an integral over \\([0,1]\\) can be viewed as the expectation of a function of a uniform random variable, especially when the integrand involves digit expansions or floor expressions.

callouts.id: 对自变量进行二进制展开求积分#3
callouts.title: 命题1：对均匀分布的随机变量的二进制展开
callouts.body:
令$X_1,...,X_n,...$是概率空间$(\Omega,\mathcal{F},P)$当中的一列随机变量，定义$$Y(\omega):=\sum_{n\geq 1}\frac{X_n(\omega)}{2^n}$$那么
1. 如果$X_k \sim U(\{0,1\})$是一列独立同分布的随机变量,那么$Y\sim U(0,1)$是一个均匀分布的随机变量。
3. 如果$Y\sim U(0,1)$那么$X_k\sim$是一列独立同分布的且满足$X_k \sim U(\{0,1\})$的随机变量。

classification_result.id: 对自变量进行二进制展开求积分#3
classification_result.english_title: Proposition 1: Binary Expansion of a Uniformly Distributed Random Variable

if_problem.statement_en: Let \\(X_1,X_2,\\dots\\) be random variables on a probability space \\((\\Omega,\\mathcal F,P)\\), and define $$Y(\\omega):=\\sum_{n\\geq 1}\\frac{X_n(\\omega)}{2^n}.$$ Then: 1. If \\(X_k\\sim U(\\{0,1\\})\\) are independent and identically distributed, then \\(Y\\sim U(0,1)\\). 2. Conversely, if \\(Y\\sim U(0,1)\\), then the binary digits \\(X_k\\) form an independent and identically distributed sequence with \\(X_k\\sim U(\\{0,1\\})\\).

callouts.id: 对自变量进行二进制展开求积分#4
callouts.title: 二进制表示
callouts.body: 此处我们讨论的二进制表示是无穷没有终止的二进制表示。这就好比，在十进制当中，我们就可以用$0.1$表示某个小数，但是我们选择用$0.09999...$来表示同一个实数。在二进制当中也是类似的做法，这样的好处是，每一个小数都对应一个无穷序列。

callouts.title: 基本想法
callouts.body: 直接算其累积分布函数$F_{Y}(y)$，如果我们可以得到$F_{Y}(y)=y$那么$Y$一定是$U(0,1)$的随机变量。

if_strategy_template.strategy_name_en: Show Uniformity by Computing the CDF
if_strategy_template.summary_en: Compute the cumulative distribution function \\(F_Y(y)\\). If one can prove \\(F_Y(y)=y\\) on the relevant interval, then \\(Y\\) is uniformly distributed on \\((0,1)\\).
if_strategy_template.applicability: Applies when proving that a random variable has the uniform distribution, especially when the variable is defined indirectly through a digit expansion or series.

callouts.id: 对自变量进行二进制展开求积分#6
callouts.title: r进制的两个小数比大小
callouts.body: 假设两个实数$a,b\in (0,1)$其$r$进制表示的前$k$位($k\geq 1$)都相等，第$k+1$位上的数字$a_{k+1}>b_{k+1}$，那么$a>b$.

classification_result.id: 对自变量进行二进制展开求积分#6
classification_result.english_title: Comparing Two Decimals in Base r

if_problem.statement_en: Suppose two real numbers \\(a,b\\in(0,1)\\) have the same first \\(k\\) digits in their base-\\(r\\) expansions, with \\(k\\ge 1\\), and the \\((k+1)\\)-st digit satisfies \\(a_{k+1}>b_{k+1}\\). Then \\(a>b\\).

callouts.id: 对自变量进行二进制展开求积分#7
callouts.title: Cantor集合的Lebesgue测度
callouts.body: 定义Cantor集合$C$为闭区间$[0,1]$的一个子集，其元素由那些三进制表示中不包含数字1的$[0,1]$中的实数构成。$m$是实数上的Lebesgue测度，那么$$m(C)=0$$

classification_result.id: 对自变量进行二进制展开求积分#7
classification_result.english_title: Lebesgue Measure of the Cantor Set

if_problem.statement_en: Define the Cantor set \\(C\\) as the subset of \\([0,1]\\) consisting of those real numbers whose ternary expansions do not contain the digit 1. If \\(m\\) denotes Lebesgue measure on \\(\\mathbb R\\), then $$m(C)=0.$$

callouts.id: 对自变量进行二进制展开求积分#8
callouts.title: 问题3.1
callouts.body: 求积分的结果：$$\int_{0}^{1}\left(\sum_{n\geq 1}\frac{a_n(x)}{3^n}\right)^2\,dx$$其中$a_n(x)$为$x$的十进制表示的第$n$位对应的整数。

classification_result.id: 对自变量进行二进制展开求积分#8

if_problem.statement_en: Compute the integral $$\\int_{0}^{1}\\left(\\sum_{n\\geq 1}\\frac{a_n(x)}{3^n}\ight)^2\\,dx,$$ where \\(a_n(x)\\) is the integer given by the \\(n\\)-th digit in the decimal expansion of \\(x\\).
key_techniques: independence of digits of a uniform variable
